Q: When installing requests with UV, VS code cannot find requests module, but the script runs successfully from the command line A:

Never mind. The fix is:

in VS Code:

F1, Python: Select Interpreter, Python 3.12

Q: Codeigniter - passing multiple value to view A:

Let's assume you use array on your view, I can assume that because you initialize $data with array.

First, make sure you read this userguide on the result_array() section.

then change $query->result(); to $query->result_array();

then try to var_dump() it.

Q: Error when executing : dart pub global activate flutterfire_cli A:

first you should install git then add these paths to the envirnoment variables

C:\Program Files\Git\bin\git.exe
C:\Program Files\Git\cmd
C:\Windows\System32

finaly right click on your IDE and Choose >> propertise >> copmatibility >>run this program as an admininstrator
